title: What generative AI can do · Level 2
slo: Identify what generative AI is and match it to common workplace uses.

exercises.question_text: Which are common uses of generative AI? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Marketing posts are newly generated content. They are a workplace use of generative AI.
Generative AI can support natural-language customer responses. Virtual agents use this capability.
Study guides are content that can be generated for learners. This is a workplace application.
A TPM limit controls processing capacity. It does not create workplace content.

exercises.explanation: Correct—these choices involve generated content or responses.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts into a correct sentence.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with Copilot, then state its output, input, and users.

exercises.correct_answer: Copilot can write product descriptions from prompts for marketers
exercises.explanation: The sentence names the tool, its marketing output, the input, and the users.

exercises.question_text: Generative AI is a subset of ___.

parts.text: Generative AI is a subset of

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The relationship between generative AI and the broader field would be incorrect.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Generative AI belongs within artificial intelligence and specializes in creating new content.

exercises.explanation: Generative AI is a subset of artificial intelligence; its distinguishing feature is creating new content.

exercises.question_text: A launch manager needs consistent website, blog, and social copy quickly. Which actions should the manager choose? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Product descriptions provide launch copy for the website. Copilot can help create them quickly.
A blog post is written campaign content. It supports the launch need.
Social copy is a stated Copilot marketing use. It helps coordinate messaging across channels.

options.text: Deploy a virtual agent for inquiries
options.rationale: A virtual agent addresses customer questions rather than producing campaign copy. It would not create the requested launch assets.
options.better_fit: This fits a customer-support need, especially handling customer inquiries.

feedback.intrinsic: The launch would still lack its written campaign assets.
feedback.instructional: Use Copilot marketing content for product, blog, and social copy.

exercises.explanation: Correct—these actions create the written launch content.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts into a correct sentence.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The benefit statement would be unclear.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Put the subject first, followed by its effect, result, and audience.

exercises.correct_answer: Code suggestions can speed software development for developers
exercises.explanation: The sentence expresses the development benefit of generated code suggestions.

exercises.question_text: A designer can create concept art from a text description using ___.

parts.text: A designer can create concept art from a text description using

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The required visual asset would not be produced.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use image and video generation for concept art and other visuals.

exercises.explanation: Image and video generation produces visual assets from text descriptions.

exercises.question_text: A developer describes a needed web-app feature in plain language. Which GitHub Copilot outputs could help implement it? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: A code snippet can implement part of a feature. GitHub Copilot can generate it from a prompt.
A function suggestion supports implementation. It is a GitHub Copilot output.
A module can support feature development. GitHub Copilot can write modules.
A support reply serves customers rather than implementing a web feature. It provides no code artifact for the developer.
options.better_fit: This fits an AI-powered virtual agent answering customer inquiries.

feedback.intrinsic: The developer would still lack implementation help.
feedback.instructional: Choose code snippets, functions, and modules for development.

exercises.explanation: Correct—these outputs can help build the feature.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts into a correct sentence.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The personalization statement would be unclear.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with the creator, then the material, learners, and progress.

exercises.correct_answer: Generative AI creates custom quizzes for students based on progress
exercises.explanation: The sentence identifies the generated material, its audience, and the tailoring factor.

exercises.question_text: A designer has a written campaign brief and needs a visual mockup for review. Which use best fits the need?

options.rationale: This use creates visuals from text descriptions. A written brief can serve as the description.
Marketing content produces written copy rather than visual mockups. The scenario requires a campaign image.
options.better_fit: This fits product descriptions, blog posts, and social-media copy.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would have copy but no visual mockup.
feedback.instructional: Choose image and video generation for visual assets.

options.rationale: Personalized learning creates materials for students rather than campaign mockups. It does not transform the brief into a visual asset.
options.better_fit: This fits tailored quizzes, explanations, and study guides.

feedback.intrinsic: The review would still lack the campaign visual.
feedback.instructional: Use visual generation for the mockup.

options.rationale: A virtual agent answers customer questions in natural language rather than producing images. It would not deliver the required mockup.

feedback.intrinsic: The design review would still have no visual to assess.
feedback.instructional: Use image and video generation when a text brief must become a visual asset.

exercises.explanation: Correct—the written brief can guide visual generation.

exercises.question_text: Virtual agents understand customer questions written in ___.

parts.text: Virtual agents understand customer questions written in

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The communication method would be incorrect.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Virtual agents understand questions written in natural language.

exercises.explanation: Natural language is the everyday language customers use in inquiries.

exercises.question_text: An education-platform teacher sees learners progressing at different speeds. Which outputs should the teacher choose to tailor to each learner? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Quizzes can be tailored to learner progress. They fit the classroom need.
Explanations can be adapted to a learner. They fit personalized learning.
Study guides can reflect individual progress. They support differentiated learning.
Product descriptions are marketing copy rather than learner support. They do not address students progressing at different speeds.
options.better_fit: This fits marketing content with Copilot.

feedback.intrinsic: The teacher would receive campaign copy instead of learner support.
feedback.instructional: Choose quizzes, explanations, and study guides for personalized learning.

exercises.explanation: Correct—these outputs can be tailored to each learner.

exercises.question_text: A store receives customer questions after staff leave for the day. Which solution should the manager choose to provide around-the-clock support?

options.rationale: Virtual agents can answer customer inquiries around the clock. They understand natural-language questions.
Marketing content creates campaign copy rather than after-hours support. It would not answer customers' questions.
options.better_fit: This fits product descriptions, blog posts, and social-media content.

feedback.intrinsic: Customers would still have unanswered questions.
feedback.instructional: Choose a virtual agent for continuous customer support.

options.rationale: Visual generation creates creative assets rather than support responses. It would not provide coverage for customer questions.
options.better_fit: This fits storyboards, campaign visuals, or concept art.

feedback.intrinsic: The store would gain visuals but no support coverage.
feedback.instructional: Use virtual agents for customer inquiries.

options.rationale: Personalized learning creates materials for students rather than customer-service answers. It would not resolve after-hours inquiries.
options.better_fit: This fits tailored quizzes, explanations, and study guides.

feedback.intrinsic: Customers would still need to wait for a human response.
feedback.instructional: Virtual agents are designed to handle customer questions in natural language.

exercises.explanation: Correct—virtual agents provide support around the clock.
